_comment: Maintained by scripts/rate_check (morning rate-checker). Per-box rates (Box Engine v2): ceil(least-cost ground [UPS Ground vs USPS Ground Advantage] at the box's representative billable weight + per-box packaging + 2.00 buffer). Carries BOTH shippable catalogs (GOL-2199 potted go-live 2026-09-08): bareroot small/large and potted/peat-and-bagged p24x10x4/p24x10x6. GOL-2238 (P1 correction 2026-09-14): the 2026-09-08 probe's zone_6/zone_7 split was retired — a live re-probe put TN at zone_1 (its worst corner, Memphis, quotes the zone_1 rate exactly; it borders KY/VA/NC) and folded AR/MO/IA back to their real zone_5 rate (worst corners = 23/28 small/large, 26/41 potted). zone_6/zone_7 had carried a stale interim potted ceiling (41/52) that overcharged those states; both bands are gone. See shipping_zones.ZONE_BY_STATE. Design: vault wiki/Software/Grove Shipping.
